hits_definition.external: a request from a client that is neither AF (no x-af-self/x-af-nonce, not af-probe) nor a known crawler, to any path on the AF x402 endpoint host
hits_definition.external_to_product: the subset of `external` whose path is a priced product or the manifest root; this is the page-level number, `external` alone is site-level
hits_definition.paid_hits: external_to_product hits that reached the payment layer (trial calls and AF probes excluded)
hits_definition.crawlers: tracked separately in crawler_hits and never subtracted from paid_hits; reachability reads this field, the funnel does not
hits_definition.best_effort: UA and referrer are self-reported, so organic classification is best-effort and not adversarial-proof: a forged UA can be misread, in either direction
hits_definition.terminal_semantic_guard: if the derived numbers are stale by more than 14 days at window close, the result is NOT MEASURED, not inconclusive_by_capability_final: the observer failed, distribution was never observed. tools/af_x402_monitor.py reports this as terminal_guard

rules.then: record the numbers as a host-capability failure log; the plan stops at the invalidated window instead of being extended; a new window needs a durable host (owner-only capability)

no external arrival at all: escalate an owner-only channel (repo homepage/topics, human directories) or declare the experiment inconclusive-by-capability. Never change the product or the price on this result, never call it a discovery failure

rules.if: external > 0 AND external_to_product == 0 AND a channel candidate is blocked
rules.then: traffic reached the host but never a priced path, and at least one channel is blocked, so distribution was never tested: unblock it or declare inconclusive. Do not call it discovery failure and do not touch the product

rules.if: external > 0 AND external_to_product == 0 AND no candidate tried yet
rules.then: arrivals never reached a priced path: check paths, redirects and the storefront link first, then run the next untried channel candidate

rules.if: external > 0 AND external_to_product == 0 AND all candidates tried AND none blocked
rules.then: declare the experiment failed for organic discovery: every channel AF can execute was tried and measured, so the gap is capability (external distribution), not product or price. Stop the plan; do not invent a fifth channel after seeing the numbers
requests reached a priced path but no 402 was issued: fix the payment layer before any conclusion about demand
change price tier or trial shape; verify with a labelled price-gate probe before claiming the price is wrong
keep the price; scale the channel that produced the payer and record the first external payment only after the tx is verified on-chain

exit_criteria.terminal_guard: stale derived data at window close -> NOT MEASURED, not inconclusive_by_capability_final

distribution.classification_reason: every inbound hyperlink is AF-authored; no external link, no crawler hit, no referrer
